cp5:1.1: Punāparaṃ yadā homi sattarājapurohito pūjito naradevehi Mahāgovindabrāhmaṇo, || ||
cp5:2.1: Tadā' haṃ sattarajjesu yaṃ me āsi upāyanaṃ tena demi mahādānaṃ akkhobhaṃ sāgar' ūpamaṃ. || ||
cp5:3.1: Na me dessaṃ dhanaṃ dhaññaṃ na pi natthi nicayo mayi sabbaññutaṃ piyaṃ mayhaṃ tasmā demi varaṃ dhanan-ti. || ||
